_comment: steamAppId is Poker Night Live's real App ID (5534910). For development without the real app you can set STEAM_APP_ID=480 (Valve's public Spacewar test app). There is no online server: each table is hosted inside the creator's game and friends connect through Steam.
_inviteComment: inviteBase: a static page (docs/join.html on GitHub Pages) that turns a copied invite into a "Join in Steam" button. It needs no server.
